sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "task_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "x" REAL NOT NULL, "y" REAL NOT NULL, "width" REAL NOT NULL, "height" REAL NOT NULL, "z_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "carried_over" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("carried_over" IN (0, 1)), "original_day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_time" TEXT NULL, "event_time_precision" TEXT NULL, "event_time_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("event_time_pending" IN (0, 1)), "due_time" TEXT NULL, "due_time_precision" TEXT NULL, "due_time_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("due_time_pending" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_cards (id), "to_card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_cards (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "carry_over_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_cards (id), "from_day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_day_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "x" REAL NOT NULL, "y" REAL NOT NULL, "width" REAL NOT NULL, "height" REAL NOT NULL, "title_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carried_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mail_export_files" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_size" INTEGER NULL, "file_modified_at" INTEGER NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_type" TEXT NULL, "mailbox" TEXT NULL, "exported_at" INTEGER NULL, "earliest_received_at" INTEGER NULL, "latest_received_at" INTEGER NULL, "mail_count" INTEGER NULL, "new_mail_count" INTEGER NULL, "skipped_count" INTEGER NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NULL, "unchanged_since" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mails" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mailbox" TEXT NOT NULL, "mail_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "mail_key_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "outlook_id" TEXT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_name" TEXT NULL, "sender_address" TEXT NULL, "received_at" INTEGER NULL, "importance" TEXT NULL, "has_attachments" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_attachments" IN (0, 1)), "has_inline_images" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_inline_images" IN (0, 1)), "body_text" TEXT NULL, "body_possibly_incomplete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("body_possibly_incomplete" IN (0, 1)), "links" TEXT NULL, "body_cleared_at" INTEGER NULL, "analysis_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "analysis_failure_type" TEXT NULL, "analysis_failure_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "category_reason" TEXT NULL, "marked_useful" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("marked_useful" IN (0, 1)), "source_file_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mail_export_files (id), "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "analyzed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("mailbox", "mail_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mail_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mail_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mails (id), "conversation_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, "actions" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "link_refs" TEXT NULL, "event_time" TEXT NULL, "event_time_precision" TEXT NULL, "event_time_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("event_time_pending" IN (0, 1)), "due_time" TEXT NULL, "due_time_precision" TEXT NULL, "due_time_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("due_time_pending" IN (0, 1)), "optional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("optional" IN (0, 1)), "has_unanalyzed_attachments" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_unanalyzed_attachments" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES task_cards (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "updated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("updated" IN (0, 1)), "related_item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES mail_items (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mail_item_updates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mail_items (id), "mail_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mails (id), "changes" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX links_one_active_per_pair ON links (min(from_card_id, to_card_id), max(from_card_id, to_card_id)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
